title: WUW-WhatYouWant
tagline: WUW is a SocialFi Network using PushAPI, XMTP, Huddle01. Multichain content, tips and ownership. Bridges useful features in one place
description:
WUW is a SocialFi Network in a multichain networks, with many features.

Using Push Protocol, you can get the best way to interact with our community.
Subscriptions, adds for company, private channel, chat, group.
In addition, you can also do a meeting live stream with Huddle01.

Directly on the dApp, you can create easily your ERC721 NFt and ERC20 tokens, and sales to another user directly with a specific pool you can create.
After your token launch, you can create a rule to use it for an entry or chat access for your channel, group, or live stream token gated!

You can also use the partners/tracks ERC20/ERC721 like BAYC, ApeCoin, sDai and more coming soon. 

We use RainbowKit for wallet connection.

Get the best way to interact with our community and engage it as never before.
Subscriptions, adds for company, private channel, chat, and group. 

Post, feed, follow, and create a community.
See whatever you want.

We want to continue to build after this hackathon, like add more contributions, social, events, DeFi features.

Tracks :
Push: V
ApeCoin: V
NextID: WIP
Spark: V partially with sDAI 

Scroll: V
Mantle: WIP
Connext: WIP


-- BUILDING in ETHGlobal and want to push and continue it after--

Future work:

Web2 connection: Other Web2 flow is in progress. We want to add with Lit Protocol for OAuth connection.
Account abstraction: Safe AA with OAuth.
Gamification: games, ranking in social Fi with NextID, and many more.
 Social aggregator: Want to be connected to Twitter and another Social network with NextID (WIP). 
Multichain integration: Deploy Connext/Hyperlane smart contract.

Analaytics: We want to add many DeFi features analytics after the SocialFi.
We want to add useful features in one place, with ease of use.
